competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II — Work in a Team Environment: naiuugnay ng BHW ang kanyang sarili sa tamang ugnayan at kapartner batay sa uri ng pangangailangan, nagpapakita ng mabuting kasanayan bilang miyembro ng koponan, at pinananatili ang sariling pagganap sa pamamagitan ng self-management.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II — Work in a Team Environment: the BHW connects themselves to the right relationship or partner based on the kind of need at hand, demonstrates good practice as a team member, and keeps their own performance on track through self-management.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Wastong itinuturo ng BHW kung sinong ugnayan (komunidad, midwife/RHU, barangay officials, kapwa BHW) ang dapat lapitan, batay sa uri ng suportang kailangan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW correctly identifies which relationship (community, midwife/RHU, barangay officials, fellow BHW) to approach, based on the kind of support needed.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Palaging iisang tao lamang (kadalasan ang midwife) ang itinuturo kahit hindi klinikal ang usapin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Consistently points to the same person (usually the midwife) even when the matter isn't clinical.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang tugon sa lahat ng ipinakitang sitwasyon, mabilis at walang pag-aalinlangan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Responds correctly to every situation shown, quickly and without hesitation.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama sa halos lahat pero kailangan ng dagdag na tanong bago makapili.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on most, but needs a follow-up question before choosing.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Palaging iisang tao lang ang isinusulong anuman ang sitwasyon.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Always defaults to the same person regardless of the situation.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nasasabi ng BHW ang tungkulin ng hindi bababa sa apat na karagdagang kakilala (hal. punong barangay, kagawad sa kalusugan, CHO/MHO, local health board) nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW states the role of at least four additional contacts (e.g. punong barangay, Kagawad sa Kalusugan, CHO/MHO, local health board) without looking at the material.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naaalala lamang ang pangalan ng titulo nang hindi maisalarawan kung ano talaga ang ginagawa o saan sila lalapitan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only recalls the title's name without being able to describe what they actually do or when to approach them.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naiuugnay ang tamang tungkulin sa hindi bababa sa anim na kakilala, may sariling halimbawa.
levels.kaya_na_en: Correctly connects the right role to at least six contacts, with an own example.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama sa dalawa o tatlo, kailangan pa ng untag para sa iba.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on two or three, needs prompting for the rest.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o wala ang tamang nailalarawan.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa isang role-play o aktwal na sitwasyon, naipapakita ng BHW ang hindi bababa sa tatlo sa limang rekomendasyon ng mabuting teamwork (malinaw na layunin, malinaw na tungkulin, pagiging bukas sa isyu, pagiging bukas sa puna, ugnayan sa labas ng trabaho).
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a role-play or an actual situation, the BHW demonstrates at least three of the five good-teamwork recommendations (clear purpose, clear roles, openness to issues, openness to feedback, relationships outside work).
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nananahimik sa isyu ng koponan hanggang lumaki ito, o hindi tumatanggap ng puna nang maayos.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Stays silent about a team issue until it grows, or does not take feedback gracefully.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Aktibong naipapakita ang hindi bababa sa apat na rekomendasyon sa isang tunay o ginayang sitwasyon.
levels.kaya_na_en: Actively demonstrates at least four recommendations in a real or role-played situation.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May naipapakitang dalawa o tatlo, pero kailangan pa ng untag.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Demonstrates two or three, but needs prompting.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa o wala ang naipapakitang rekomendasyon.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagsusulat ang BHW ng isang SMART goal at isang lingguhang plano ng trabaho, at nasasabi niya kung aling anim na kasanayan sa self-management ang pinakamalakas at pinakakailangan pang paunlarin sa kanya.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW writes a SMART goal and a weekly work plan, and states which of the six self-management skills is their strength and which needs the most work.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ang naisulat na 'goal' ay pangkalahatan lamang ('gagaling ako'), hindi nasusukat o walang hangganan sa oras.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: The written 'goal' is only general ('I'll get better'), not measurable, and has no time limit.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na SMART goal, lingguhang plano, at tapat na pagsusuri sa sariling kasanayan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Has a specific SMART goal, a weekly plan, and an honest self-assessment of their skills.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May naisulat pero kulang sa isa sa limang bahagi ng SMART (tiyak, nasusukat, naaabot, makatotohanan, may hangganan sa oras).
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has something written but is missing one of SMART's five parts (specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, time-bound).
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Walang naisulat na goal o plano, o hindi matukoy ang sariling kalakasan at kahinaan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Has no written goal or plan, or cannot identify their own strengths and weaknesses.
